{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # identify marker color as nonzero color appearing sparsely, and frame color as dominant nonzero
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if x)
    if not cnt: return g
    frame=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers=[(i,j,x) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x and x!=frame]
    # rays aligned with frame bounding box; extend through bbox, preserving frame
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==frame]
    if not cells:return g
    rmin=min(i for i,j in cells); rmax=max(i for i,j in cells); cmin=min(j for i,j in cells); cmax=max(j for i,j in cells)
    for i,j,x in markers:
        if rmin<=i<=rmax and j==cmin or rmin<=i<=rmax and j==cmax:
            for c in range(min(j,cmin),max(j,cmax)+1):
                if g[i][c]==0:g[i][c]=x
        elif cmin<=j<=cmax and i==rmin or cmin<=j<=cmax and i==rmax:
            for r in range(min(i,rmin),max(i,rmax)+1):
                if g[r][j]==0:g[r][j]=x
    return g"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if x!=0)
    frame=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x not in (0,frame)]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i,j in pts:
        # choose direction toward nearest frame cell in same row/column
        candidates=[]
        for di,dj in ((0,-1),(0,1),(-1,0),(1,0)):
            a,b=i+di,j+dj
            while 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W:
                if g[a][b]==frame:
                    candidates.append((abs(a-i)+abs(b-j),di,dj)); break
                a+=di;b+=dj
        if not candidates: continue
        _,di,dj=min(candidates)
        a,b=i+di,j+dj
        while 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]!=frame:
            if g[a][b]==0: g[a][b]=g[i][j]
            a+=di;b+=dj
    return g"}
